## Attendance

The programme board met in October 2020. Present: J. Whitfield, S. Rahman, Priya Anand, R. Adeyemi, G. Evans. The meeting was chaired by J. Whitfield.

The attendance record was noted, and the board proceeded with the review of activity, outstanding work and correspondence. No apologies or changes to membership were recorded.

## Performance

Activity for October 2020 was 1512 captures. The board reviewed the current position and noted the outstanding volumes requiring continued monitoring.

The recorded breaches were a grader backlog of 144 and a letter bureau total of 1. Members noted these figures and agreed that they should remain visible in routine performance reporting until the position improves.

## Items

No new incidents or changes were reported to the board. The existing position was reviewed, with no further matters raised for escalation. Members were asked to continue reporting any material developments through the established route so that they can be considered at the next meeting.

## Actions

The chair will circulate actions arising from the meeting. Members should review the circulated actions and provide any amendments or updates through the usual process. Progress against the agreed actions will be considered at the next board meeting, alongside the latest activity and outstanding work position.
